description: Audio-only coarse pass: remove the obviously playback-irrelevant capabilities (programs, network, devices, avdevice, avfilter, swscale, encoders, muxers, video/subtitle decoders). Demuxers, parsers, protocols (non-network), bsfs and swresample stay default-enabled. Answers: how much does deleting the obviously irrelevant save?
notes: decoder=audio-only is generated mechanically from the pinned FFmpeg source (see scripts/build-profile): every decoder whose codec descriptor type is AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO. Video and subtitle decoders stay off.
demuxers stay enabled: a container like MKV/MOV is still a valid carrier of audio tracks; N2 performs the fine-grained cut.
